# When readings in context glue, for parity

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`gluing-under-parity` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](gluing-under-parity.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where each context requires a parity, a context-free reading exists exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts (each claim counted evenly, the parities adding to odd); then mixtures of context-free readings meet at most m − 1 of the m contexts on average, readings in context all m.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Arithmetic of parity: parities added (addParity) and the parity of a quantity over a list (oddOver); association, exchange and self-cancelling, parity carried through maps and termwise addition, and the bounds on counting. (`Becoming.addParity`, `Becoming.oddOver`, `Becoming.addParity_false`, `Becoming.addParity_self`, `Becoming.addParity_assoc`, `Becoming.addParity_swap`, `Becoming.addParity_and`, `Becoming.addParity_solve`, `Becoming.addParity_cancel`, `Becoming.true_of_ne_false`, `Becoming.cond_le_one`, `Becoming.and_congr_of`, `Becoming.oddOver_add`, `Becoming.oddOver_and`, `Becoming.oddOver_congr`, `Becoming.oddOver_false`, `Becoming.oddOver_swap`, `Becoming.oddOver_map`, `Becoming.preimage_of_mem_map`, `Becoming.count_le_length`, `Becoming.count_all`, `Becoming.met_step`, `Becoming.even_le_of_odd`)
2. A parity constraint gives the claims it counts and the parity it requires; constraints added are a constraint; a list of constraints contradicts where, added, it counts no listed claim and requires odd; where they contradict, every assignment fails an odd number of them. (`Becoming.ParityConstraint`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.add`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value_add`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.Contradicts`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.value_even`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.unmet_odd`)
3. Elimination: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, the listed claims are eliminated one at a time, as in solving linear equations over two values; for every list of constraints either an assignment meets each or a selection of them contradicts, a contradiction found after an elimination carried back to the constraints it came from. (`Becoming.ParityConstraint.eliminate`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.counts_after`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.eliminate_counts`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.met_after`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.pulled`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.pull_back`, `Becoming.ParityConstraint.met_or_contradicts`)
4. A parity system gives each context the claims it counts and the parity it requires (ParitySystem); an assignment lies within a context's possibilities where its parity on the counted claims is the required one, which depends only on the claims within the context; a contradiction is a selection of contexts, repetition allowed, counting every claim an even number of times while the required parities add up to odd. (`Becoming.ParitySystem`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.constraint`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.within`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.value`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.support`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.met`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.Contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.local_`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.contradicts_iff`)
5. The obstruction: every context-free assignment fails an odd number of a contradiction's contexts, one found by checking each, so no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities; it meets at most m − 1 of the m contexts, and so does a mixture (assignments counted with repetition) on average; where each context can be met alone, readings indexed by context meet all m. (`Becoming.ParitySystem.unmet_odd`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.unmet_of_contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.contradicts_noGlobal`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.met_le`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.mixture_le`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.indexed_met`)
6. The only obstruction: with equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition, for every list of contexts a context-free assignment meets each or a selection contradicts; so, the contexts listed, no context-free reading exists exactly where a selection contradicts, and a world showing what each context counts, respecting the possibilities and gluing, exists exactly where none does. (`Becoming.ParitySystem.lift_selection`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.global_or_contradicts`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.noGlobal_iff`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.glues_iff`)
7. Specker's three boxes: each opening counts its two boxes and requires odd; the three openings contradict, every mixture meets at most two of the three on average, and each opening read by its own placement meets all three; Becoming.Context's Specker.noGlobal follows from the contradiction. (`Becoming.Specker.paritySystem`, `Becoming.Specker.two_iff`, `Becoming.Specker.two_iff_swap`, `Becoming.Specker.support_iff`, `Becoming.Specker.openings`, `Becoming.Specker.openings_contradict`, `Becoming.Specker.noGlobal`, `Becoming.Specker.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Specker.indexed_met`)
8. The CHSH game (Clauser, Horne, Shimony and Holt, 1969): two stations with two settings each, whose outcomes must differ exactly where both settings are the second; the four pairs of settings contradict, every mixture of context-free outcomes wins at most three of the four on average (the classical bound), and outcomes read in their pair win all four. (`Becoming.CHSH.Outcome`, `Becoming.CHSH.outcomes`, `Becoming.CHSH.same`, `Becoming.CHSH.paritySystem`, `Becoming.CHSH.two_iff`, `Becoming.CHSH.support_iff`, `Becoming.CHSH.pairs`, `Becoming.CHSH.pairs_contradict`, `Becoming.CHSH.mixture_le`, `Becoming.CHSH.inPair`, `Becoming.CHSH.inPair_support`, `Becoming.CHSH.indexed_met`)
9. The Mermin–Peres square: each line counts its three cells, and only the third column requires odd; the six lines contradict, every mixture meets at most five of the six on average, and values read in their line meet all six; Becoming.Context's Square.noGlobal follows from the contradiction. (`Becoming.Square.cells`, `Becoming.Square.counts`, `Becoming.Square.paritySystem`, `Becoming.Square.lines`, `Becoming.Square.three_iff`, `Becoming.Square.not_beyond`, `Becoming.Square.support_iff`, `Becoming.Square.cells_even`, `Becoming.Square.lines_contradict`, `Becoming.Square.noGlobal`, `Becoming.Square.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Square.inLine`, `Becoming.Square.inLine_support`, `Becoming.Square.indexed_met`)
10. A cycle: the claims 0, …, n in a cycle, neighbours related as equal or different (Gluing.Cycle.system), each claim counted twice along its relations; so with an odd number of differ relations they contradict and mixtures meet at most n of the n + 1 on average; with an even number the assignment walked along the cycle meets them all, and the two exclude each other (Gluing.Cycle.met_iff_even). (`Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.down`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.system`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.edges`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.polarity`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.length_edges`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.lt_of_mem_down`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.shift`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.cross`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.returns`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.eq_of_even`, `Becoming.beq_self`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.beq_of_ne`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.telescope`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.counts_even`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.contradicts`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.mixture_le`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.miss`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.pick`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.value_pair`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.walk`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.walk_meets`, `Becoming.Gluing.Cycle.met_iff_even`)
11. Along a run, what the contexts show glues at a step exactly where the world of readings is context-free there. With claims listed once and contexts listed, a respecting world of readings is context-free at a step, and (each claim in some context) a frame of context-free claims of any process fits, exactly where no selection contradicts; where m contexts contradict, a world context-free at a step meets at most m − 1. (`Becoming.Contextual.FreeAt`, `Becoming.Contextual.glues_iff_freeAt`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.met_congr`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.world_free_iff`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.world_met_le`, `Becoming.ParitySystem.freeFrame_iff`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The claims and contexts are listed; the obstruction and the m − 1 bound need nothing more; uniqueness (elimination) takes equality of claims decided and the claims listed without repetition; a mixture is a list of assignments counted with repetition, its weights natural numbers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The quantum values: Tsirelson's bound needs real amplitudes and is not stated here (Becoming.Quantum realizes the square with integer matrices).
- Contextuality beyond parity constraints (general possibilities, probabilistic contextuality) is given no exact law.
- Which readings in context of an actual unfolding are of this parity kind: that is correspondence.
- Readings indexed by context meet all m only where each context can be met alone; without a contradiction nothing more follows about them. Witness: `Becoming.ParitySystem.indexed_met`.
- **Counterexample:** Specker's boxes, CHSH and the Mermin–Peres square: each contradicts, so no context-free reading exists, while readings indexed by context meet every context; a cycle with an odd number of differ relations contradicts likewise. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Gluing.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren asked on 12 October 2026 whether what a frame loses is like “wave/particle”, and agreed with the reply reading a value as what a context shows; on 15 October 2026: “please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”. This result is the next step of contextual-registration, “the general parity obstruction; probabilistic contextuality”: for parity constraints, “context-free claims are a commitment of the representation” becomes an exact law, the commitment failing exactly at a checkable obstruction, which gives a Bell-type bound. The parity law is Gaussian elimination over GF(2), the Fredholm alternative for linear systems; all-versus-nothing parity proofs are Mermin's (1990) and the Mermin–Peres square's, the cohomological parity criterion is Abramsky, Barbosa, Kishida, Lal and Mansfield's (2015, “Contextuality, cohomology and paradox”), and parity games are Arkhipov's (2012). Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D33): the difference between m − 1 and m is what the context carries; a value is what a context shows, a relation.

Reuses Contextual, Contextual.Glues, Contextual.Respects, Contextual.not_glues, Local and NoGlobal, and the possibilities, world and respects of Specker and Square: a parity system's possibilities are local, and its instances' possibilities are those there.
  - Output: Claims shown in context, gluing, locality and no context-free reading; the possibilities of Specker and Mermin–Peres.
  - Input: A parity system's contradiction gives no context-free reading and no gluing.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Context.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [more-needs-renewers](more-needs-renewers.md). Reuses total, total_le, total_add, total_ones, count, Distinct, search, mem_cons_cases and mem_map_of: counting and checking along a list.
  - Output: Totals and counts over a list; a list without repetition; checking one by one.
  - Input: The mixture's average bound; checking one by one in elimination.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Flow.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [unity-of-readings](unity-of-readings.md). Readings in context are always one world of indexed claims, with no gluing; here, when a context-free reading exists under parity constraints.
- related, not a proved adapter: [separation-loses-the-relation](separation-loses-the-relation.md). A separated description gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a context-free reading exists exactly where nothing contradicts: both locate exactly what a description loses.
